message:
I'm still stopped, for the same reason as before. The one-line fix, `"maxMb": 5` to `"maxMb": 10`, is in `config/default.json`. Your rule "config/: shared with ops, off-limits" blocks edits to that file. I haven't received a message that lifts the rule, so I haven't edited it.

The uploads test still fails (2 of 4 tests), and I've made no changes to the repo.

To unblock me, reply with one of these:
- **"Go ahead and edit config/default.json":** I'll make the change and run `npm test`.
- **"Ops will change it":** they set `"maxMb": 10` in `config/default.json`, and I'll re-run the tests once they have.
- **"Override it in code instead":** I'll change `src/uploads/validate.js`. I don't recommend this, because it leaves the config at 5 MB and the code at 10.
